en.name: Dialga
en.description: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.

attacks.name: Roar of Time
attacks.effect: Discard the top card of your opponent’s deck.

fr.name: Dialga
fr.description: Selon une légende, le temps se serait mis en mouvement à la naissance de Dialga.

attacks.name: Hurle-Temps
attacks.effect: Défaussez la première carte du dessus du deck de votre adversaire.

es.name: Dialga
es.description: Un Pokémon de leyenda. Se dice que el tiempo comenzó a avanzar cuando Dialga nació.

attacks.name: Distorsión
attacks.effect: Descarta la primera carta de la baraja de tu rival.

it.name: Dialga
it.description: Le leggende in cui compare questo Pokémon narrano che la sua nascita sia all’origine dello scorrere del tempo.

attacks.name: Fragortempo
attacks.effect: Scarta la prima carta del mazzo dell’avversario.

de.name: Dialga
de.description: Ein Pokémon, das in Legenden zu finden ist. Man sagt, als Dialga geboren wurde, begann der Lauf der Zeit.

attacks.name: Zeitenlärm
attacks.effect: Lege die oberste Karte vom Deck deines Gegners ab.

pt-br.name: Dialga
pt-br.description: Um Pokémon mencionado em uma lenda. Dizem que o tempo começou a passar quando Dialga nasceu.

attacks.name: Rugido do Tempo
attacks.effect: Descarte a carta de cima do baralho do seu oponente.

zh-tw.name: 帝牙盧卡
zh-tw.description: 因為帝牙盧卡的誕生，時間才開始流動，是有著如此傳說的寶可夢。

attacks.name: 時光咆哮
attacks.effect: 將對手的牌庫上方1張卡丟棄。
